from pathlib import Path
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import socket
import subprocess
import time

B = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
P = Path('<evidence-home-1>/projects/AIMA-public-r1191-candidate')
root = B / 'gdn-separate-replay-domain-audit-r1'
sha = lambda p: hashlib.file_digest(p.open('rb'), 'sha256').hexdigest()
read = lambda p: json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
manifest = read(root / 'original-manifest.json')
original = read(root / 'residual-domain-analysis-r1.json')
files = ['full-w-bf16.bin', 'full-u-bf16.bin', 'full-v-new-bf16.bin',
         'full-k-normalized-bf16.bin', 'full-chunk-state-bf16.bin', 'full-g-cumsum-f32.bin']
for name in files:
    expected = next(x for x in manifest['files'] if x['file'] == name)
    path = root / name
    assert path.stat().st_size == expected['bytes'] and sha(path) == expected['sha256']
table = root / 'sm121-exp2-negative-f490940d.bin'
assert sha(table) == 'f490940df2bd80421159a96424c3e922330b7ca120d5ae7b629a973b9183730b'
source = B / 'audit_gdn_hybrid_wh_admission_r1.cpp'
exe = B / 'audit-gdn-hybrid-wh-admission-r1'
assert not exe.exists()
command = ['c++', '-std=c++17', '-O2', '-Wall', '-Wextra', '-Werror', '-ffp-contract=off',
           '-fsanitize=address,undefined', '-fno-sanitize-recover=all', '-I', str(P), str(source), '-o', str(exe)]
build = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
record = dict(utc=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.UTC).isoformat(), host=socket.gethostname(),
    source_file=source.name, source_sha256=sha(source), original_manifest_sha256=sha(root / 'original-manifest.json'),
    original_residual_analysis_sha256=sha(root / 'residual-domain-analysis-r1.json'),
    additional_u_copy_sha256=sha(B / 'gdn-hybrid-admission-u-copy-r1.json'),
    inputs={n: sha(root / n) for n in files}, table_sha256=sha(table),
    compile=dict(command=command, returncode=build.returncode, stdout=build.stdout, stderr=build.stderr),
    header_sha256={name: sha(P / name) for name in [
        'tools/audit_gdn_replay_domain.cpp', 'native/providers/gdn/absolute_dot_bound.h',
        'native/providers/gdn/consumer_interval.h', 'native/providers/gdn/sm121_exp2_table.h',
        'native/providers/moe_accumulator/sm121_projection_interval.h',
        'native/providers/moe_accumulator/sm121_pv_error_bound.h',
        'native/providers/moe_accumulator/q1_moe_hawkeye_bf16_accumulator.h']},
    native_executed=False, runtime_changed=False, inference_acceptance=False, performance_acceptance=False)
if build.returncode == 0:
    start = time.monotonic()
    run_command = [str(exe), str(root)]
    run = subprocess.run(run_command, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=180)
    record.update(command=run_command, executable_sha256=sha(exe), returncode=run.returncode,
                  stdout=run.stdout, stderr=run.stderr, wall_seconds=time.monotonic() - start)
    if run.returncode == 0:
        record['analysis'] = json.loads(run.stdout)
out = B / 'gdn-hybrid-wh-admission-analysis-r1.json'
with out.open('x') as f:
    json.dump(record, f, indent=2)
    f.write('\n')
print(json.dumps(dict(file=out.name, sha256=sha(out), compile_returncode=build.returncode,
                     returncode=record.get('returncode'), analysis=record.get('analysis'),
                     stderr=record.get('stderr', build.stderr)[-2000:])), flush=True)
build.check_returncode()
run.check_returncode()
